title: Execute the work29 to work31 cutover on the vuoro-shared appservice primary

blockers.description: The work31 helper refuses every other database session, so a persistent DB monitor plus helper stages need a separately reviewed session/phase handoff protocol. Until it and the full policy/data-plane fence are proven the prepared Jobs are not admitted (runbook, last section).
blockers.resolved_by: appservice source item: reviewed monitor/helper phase handoff, then an adversarial review of the Work31 procedure. Do not reroute the earlier platform-blocked review; request a fresh scoped review

blockers.description: Fresh coherent pre31 Work and Workspace recovery pair, bound to exact source/storage/backup identities and restored in isolation under the same fence, does not exist yet.
blockers.resolved_by: appservice source item: paired-evidence handoff and restore generator review (runbook, 'Paired recovery preparation')

blockers.description: PR2153 (pin service 0.1.103 for work31) is open; startup does not migrate, so it must not merge before the migration completes.
blockers.resolved_by: merge PR2153 only after step 5 below succeeds

why_operator: Live schema migration on the shared production primary under a continuous writer, Flux, network and database fence is outside standing source-only authority (handoffs 2026-11-05, 2026-11-06) and needs the operator's explicit field-window approval.
host: operator workstation with the vuoro-shared kubeconfig

preconditions.check: PR2153 still open at the reviewed head
preconditions.expected: state OPEN, headRefOid equals the reviewed head

preconditions.check: Live primary is exactly work schema 29 and service 0.1.101 is ready
preconditions.expected: running service 0.1.101 ready 1/1; a different schema or service means inspect and refuse

preconditions.check: Rendered Jobs are byte-identical to the reviewed render
preconditions.expected: renderer present; exact render arguments come with the reviewed phase handoff

commands.command: Establish the continuous fence per docs/runbooks/vuoro-workspace-continuous-fence.md and record the fence receipt
commands.expected: monitored writer, Flux, scheduled-job, network and DB fence held; receipt written

commands.command: Capture the fresh pre31 pair: prepare-fresh-dump31.py, prepare-dump-identity31.py, seal-pair31.py, then isolated restore with provision-restore-secrets31.py and check-pre31-restored-objects.py
commands.expected: sealed pre31 pair and an isolated restore whose catalog matches the source

commands.command: Apply the rendered preflight, migrate, grants and postcheck Jobs in order under the fence
commands.expected: owner migration reports [30, 31]; postcheck verifies work31 delegation and receipt catalogs and ACLs

commands.command: Capture and independently restore the post31 pair; run check-post31-restored-objects.py
commands.expected: post31 checker passes on the isolated restore

commands.command: Merge PR2153, let Flux roll service 0.1.103, then lift the fence through the reviewed guarded steps

expected_result: Primary at work31, service 0.1.103 running, pre31 and post31 pairs retained with restore evidence, fence lifted through reviewed steps, no retried unknown outcome.
send_back: Fence receipt ID and the monitor log covering the window
Job names, completion status and the postcheck output
Pre31 and post31 pair seal digests and checker outputs
Any lost response or refusal verbatim (do not retry)

rollback.description: Before step 3: lift the fence, nothing changed. After a failed or unknown step 3: stop, inspect owner state, and restore the sealed pre31 pair into service only through the reviewed restore procedure; never retry automatically.
